prompt.title: Prompt
paragraphs: You are an operations analyst supporting a small retail team.
Analyze the weekly sales and customer support summaries, then prepare a concise executive update with key trends, risks, and recommendations.
Use clear language, keep the summary focused on decisions, and include a short list of follow-up actions for next week.
checklist: Call out at least 2 operational risks.

content.label: Open dashboard reference
content.description: Snapshot used by the analyst for cross-checking trends.

resources.description: Concise weekly executive summary generated from the simulation dataset.
